stage1.impression: A murky, evenly dim brown-red box with no pools of light: the red speaker is the only thing that registers, and a side table with a Bell lamp sits right across its horn, so even the hero is cut in half. At 1:1 the concrete is blotchy noise with a red stain rather than formwork, the record wall is a regular barcode of stripes with no highlights, the frosted screen reads as a grey sheet with a dark ring artifact, and the leather chair is a flat dark shape. It reads as a competent but lifeless CG proof, not a night photograph.

blocking_9: The Ember speaker seen whole and unobstructed, its horn and both cabinet modules readable at a glance (upper module lum_median >= 45, not 24)
Real pools of light with dark between them: the frame's lum_range per major region > 40, not the current 17 to 26 on wall and screen
Neutral surfaces neutral: concrete reads warm grey (r/b ratio under about 1.6), not orange-red (r 36 / b 12 now), so the speaker is the only saturated colour
Screen panel reads as a back-lit frosted panel with a soft, legible image, clearly brighter than the wall around it (median >= 50)
Board-formed concrete shows boards, tie holes and pour lines at 1:1; records show varied spines with small highlights
Signs of life (a record out of its sleeve, a glass with a highlight, a coat on the chair) and a full-resolution 2400 x 1600 frame with no denoiser blotch

defects.what: Side table and Bell lamp stand directly in front of the speaker's horn and lower module; the lamp's glass shade reads as a wire cone slicing across the horn
Upper speaker module almost invisible: lum_median 24, range 16.6, a dark smudge on the wall
Frosted screen barely brighter than the wall (median 28.2 vs 22.7) so it reads as a grey sheet; the image is a hard dark ring that looks like a shading artifact, not a fogged silhouette
Concrete is mottled noise with a red blotch from speaker spill; no board marks, tie holes or pour lines readable; flat (range 17.5, falloff 19 to 29.5 top to bottom)
Record wall reads as a repeated barcode: uniform stripes, no sleeve highlights, no gaps or records leaning; dark (median 19.3)
Leather chairs are flat dark silhouettes with no sheen or creasing (median 19.5), cut by the frame edge
Global orange cast: neutral surfaces carry r_median about 2.5 to 3 times b_median; whole frame warm-red with no white point
Fir beam at the top is a vague dark wedge with no grain or checks
Floor has no polish or reflection of the speaker's glow; red light spill on the floor reads as a stain

changes.problem: The hero speaker is obstructed by the side table and Bell lamp and sits small in the middle of the frame.

evidence.measured: table and lamp cover roughly the left third of the horn and lower module; speaker occupies about 7 % of the frame

change.to: move the camera about 0.5 m toward y (left), e.g. position [14.6, 3.3, 1.1], target [16.3, 4.75, 1.0], 35 mm, so the side table and Bell sit to the left of the speaker with clear air between them and the speaker fills about a third of the frame height-wise from floor to top module, refocus on the horn at [16.15, 4.85, 0.75]

changes.expected: Speaker silhouette complete, both modules and the horn mouth unobstructed; Bell reads as a lit lamp beside it, not across it.

changes.problem: The upper speaker module and the speaker's acrylic do not glow; the hero is read only from its lower box.

change.setting: the lamps and pinholes on the speakers (on each Ember speaker 4 x area)
change.to: add one area light behind/above each module aimed at the white batts so light passes through the tinted acrylic: upper module 30 W/m2, lower 20 W/m2, 2900 K; keep the front fill at 8 W/m2

changes.expected: Upper module reads as tinted red acrylic with visible batts and polished glowing edges.

changes.problem: The grade turns every neutral surface orange-red, so the speaker is not the only colour.

change.setting: render white_balance_k and source colour temperatures
change.from: white_balance_k 3000; sconces/pendants 2400 K, record wall 2500 K
change.to: white_balance_k 2600; raise the pendants and record wall to 2700 K, keep candles at 1900 K as the only deep-amber accents

changes.expected: Concrete reads warm grey under tungsten, fir reads honey-brown, the red is reserved for the speaker.

changes.problem: No pools of light: every region is the same low grey, so the room reads flat and lifeless rather than cozy.

evidence.measured: lum_range 17.5; profile top to bottom 19 to 29.5 with no peak; frame below_40_pct 90.2

change.setting: pendants and the record wall spots; haze
change.from: pendants 3 x 60 W cone 50 deg; record wall 3 x 6 W cone 12 deg; haze 0.02
change.to: aim one pendant spot (60 W, cone 35 deg) to graze the concrete beside the speaker from above, record wall spots to 25 W each, cone 20 deg, raking down the shelves; haze 0.035 so the beams carry

changes.expected: A grazing pool on the concrete that falls off downward and shows the board texture, lit bands down the record wall, dark between them.

changes.problem: The frosted screen is too dim to read as a back-lit panel, and its image reads as a dark ring artifact.

change.setting: the screens' images emission; frosted acrylic roughness
change.to: emission 2.0, and raise the frosted acrylic's roughness so the image behind it blurs to a soft silhouette with no hard dark rim

changes.expected: Panel glows softly and evenly, clearly a light source in the room, image suggestive not graphic.

changes.problem: Concrete reads as blotchy noise, not board-formed concrete.

evidence.measured: 3x crop shows uniform speckle, no board seams or tie holes; red spill blotch near 400,230

change.to: increase the board-grain bump and seam depth (boards about 150 mm, seams visible), add tie holes on a 600 mm grid and faint vertical staining, a slight sheen (roughness about 0.75) so the grazing pendant picks them up

changes.expected: At 1:1 the wall shows boards, seams and tie holes under the grazing light.

changes.problem: Records read as a repeated barcode and the room has little sign of life.

evidence.measured: median 19.3, uniform striping in 2x crop, no highlights

change.to: on the record wall: several records pulled half out, two face-out sleeves, a few gaps and leaning stacks; a record out of its sleeve on the side table; a coat over the left chair; a lit candle in an amber votive on the side table

changes.expected: Record wall reads as a real, used collection; the frame has a sign of life near the speaker.

changes.problem: Leather chairs and floor are flat dark shapes with no sheen; the floor does not reflect the speaker's glow.

evidence.measured: chair lum_median 19.5, lum_range 34; floor (100,430,480,480) range 62.6 only from spill

change.to: floor roughness to about 0.3 so it carries a soft reflection of the speaker; leather roughness about 0.45 with creasing so the sconce lays a highlight along the chair's back

changes.expected: Chair reads as worn leather with a rim highlight; a soft red reflection under the speaker grounds it.

out_of_scope.request: Bell lamp's shade reads as a wire or glass cone that looks like CG
out_of_scope.why: Bell is an EARF product and fixed; the fix is the camera (c1) so it no longer crosses the speaker

out_of_scope.request: Speaker's red saturation spills onto the wall as a red blotch
out_of_scope.why: The Ember tint is fixed; only the light behind it and the grade can be tuned
